info.title: ChatBridge local HTTP API
info.description: Unofficial browser-backed ChatGPT gateway on a trusted local Mac. Browser selectors and private provider endpoints can change. A submitted request may be unknown; do not blindly resend. Project registry is local, not a provider-wide listing. The compatibility endpoint chat/completions is partial.

post.summary: Partial OpenAI-style compatibility; not a full messages contract.
Read-only recovery, never resubmit the model prompt.
Delete one remote ChatGPT chat with explicit identity and idempotency.
Start the managed browser after intentional idle
post.description: Explicitly wake the managed Chrome and wait for its verified CDP endpoint. Uses the same loopback Host, Origin, and optional bearer authentication as other gateway routes. Does not verify ChatGPT authentication.

200.description: Managed browser is running; returns browser status

401.description: Configured bearer authentication is missing or invalid

403.description: Invalid gateway Host or cross-origin request

409.description: Browser mode is mock or external

503.description: Managed browser startup failed; returns browser status and browser_unavailable error
